items.summary: Implement backend Email+Password authentication APIs in the single Motoko actor so a user can authenticate with email and password, and the backend can assign roles based on the authenticated identity.
Implement backend OTP authentication APIs in the single Motoko actor to request an OTP for an email or mobile identifier and to verify the OTP to authenticate the caller.

Update the unified frontend Login page to remove placeholder/toast-only behavior for Email+Password and OTP tabs and wire both flows to the new backend APIs, using clear English user-facing messages for success and failure states.

Ensure Admin routing behavior matches requirements across all supported login methods: after successful login, if the caller role is Admin then route to the Admin panel (/admin); otherwise route to the customer homepage (/).

Run a focused full build pass (frontend + backend) and fix any compile/runtime blockers introduced or revealed by implementing Email+Password + OTP auth, keeping changes minimal and stability-focused.
